## Decisions

- `kb:adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows` — End, Resume and Remove live in a mainhead above the focused terminal and in hover-revealed action rows on rail cards and tile footers, behind confirm dialogs. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session` — A session is live on exactly one surface at one geometry at a time; every other rendering of it is a static snapshot. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-sticky-live-membership` — Tiles grid membership is computed at view entry and density change only; afterwards only user action changes it, so a terminal never vanishes mid-keystroke. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-sticky-live-membership.md`
- `kb:adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers` — The dashboard has two peer views, Focus and Tiles, switched from the masthead or a chord, with the choice persisted daemon-side. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: views, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/tiles-live-top-n-snapshot-rest` — In Tiles the live grid holds the top N sessions by attention and every other session is a snapshot card; density sets N and every tile's geometry. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-live-top-n-snapshot-rest.md`
